profile.headline: Application/Web Developer at Fisher Clinical Services
profile.summary: Specialties: C#, VB, ASP.NET, SQL, PL/SQL, Informatica, MicroStrategy, ETL, Project Management, Application Development, Network Security, LAN Administration, Adobe Flash, Video Editing, Graphic Design, 3D Animation, Multimedia Design.

positions.title: Application/Web Developer
positions.description: In charge of all Web Applications and Web Services.

positions.title: Sr. Solutions Architect
positions.description: Was responsible for developing web application/SQL Server/Oracle solutions for pharmaceutical clients.

positions.title: Webmaster/Application Developer
positions.description: I was the only Webmaster for a 68 branch bank that had about 900 employee's.  In addition to being the Webmaster I was also a member of 4 person Application Development Department.  I speciallized in Active Directory integrated application development using the MicroSoft .Net and SQL Server frameworks.  I also had exposure to RPG AS400.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: I was responsible for completing from start to finish the entire life cycle of web design/development of over 60 websites.  I used multiple graphic applications such as PhotoShop, Flash and Fireworks to design all graphics and user interfaces for all the public websites that I worked on and programmed in ASP, ASP.NET and Coldfusion.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Started off as a Graphic Designer that quickly changed to Web Designer/Developer.  I was involved in all aspects of Web Application development including GUI design, Style Sheets, ASP, HTML and JavaScript.  I also had my first exposure to SQL Server and Oracle at this company.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: Started off as an intern working for Digial City/America Online in Philadelphia moving to a paid employee after my graduation.  I was primarily responsible for the creation of banner graphics and then moved to some HTML coding when they aquired Netscape.
